scope: Documentation observations supporting a bounded local SCRAM association implementation. This is not an AWS BatchAssociateScramSecret or SCRAM CreateGrant capture.

excerpts: A secret created with the default AWS KMS key cannot be used with an Amazon MSK cluster.
If you use the AWS CLI to create the secret, specify a key ID or ARN for the kms-key-id parameter. Don't specify an alias.
If you make any changes to the Secrets resource policy and/ or the KMS key used for secret encryption, make sure you re-associate the secrets to your MSK cluster.
